description: This file provides Xtensa-specific atomic operation implementations for the Zephyr RTOS, including atomic get, compare-and-set, set, add, subtract, increment, decrement, and bitwise operations, utilizing inline assembly for hardware atomicity.

methods.name: atomic_get
methods.description: Reads the value of an atomic variable using inline assembly with a load barrier.

methods.name: xtensa_cas
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-set operation using Xtensa-specific instructions.

methods.name: atomic_cas
methods.description: Wrapper for compare-and-set operation, returning true if successful.

methods.name: atomic_ptr_cas
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-set on atomic pointer types.

methods.name: atomic_set
methods.description: Atomically sets a variable to a specified value.

methods.name: atomic_add
methods.description: Atomically adds a value to a variable.

methods.name: atomic_sub
methods.description: Atomically subtracts a value from a variable.

methods.name: atomic_ptr_get
methods.description: Gets the value of an atomic pointer.

methods.name: atomic_ptr_set
methods.description: Sets the value of an atomic pointer.

methods.name: atomic_clear
methods.description: Clears (sets to zero) an atomic variable.

methods.name: atomic_ptr_clear
methods.description: Clears (sets to zero) an atomic pointer.
